title: PushConfig
description: PushConfig: Configuration for pushing objects to SQLite database with intelligent property mapping and filtering capabilities.

Table.description: Target table name for the push operation. If not specified, table name will be derived from object type.

PropertyMappings.description:
Property-to-column mappings using dot notation for nested properties. 
Key is the database column name, value is the object property path (e.g., 'Position.X', 'Material.Properties.Density').

ExcludedProperties.description:
Properties to exclude from automatic primitive property inclusion during table creation. 
Use this to prevent certain primitive properties from being automatically mapped to database columns. 
If empty, all primitive properties will be automatically included alongside any specified PropertyMappings.

ValidateMappings.description: Whether to validate property mappings before push operation. Default is true.

FragmentMappings.description:
Fragment-to-column mappings for extracting properties from FragmentSet. 
Key is the database column name, value is the property path within the fragment (e.g., 'Id', 'Properties.Value'). 
Fragment types are specified in FragmentTypes dictionary.

FragmentTypes.description:
Fragment type specifications for FragmentMappings. 
Key is the database column name (matching FragmentMappings keys), value is the Type of fragment to extract from FragmentSet. 
Used for type-safe casting when accessing fragments.

WrapNonBHoMObjects.description: If true, the Push action wraps any non-BHoM type into a BH.oM.Adapter.ObjectWrapper, allowing them to make use of the full Adapter workflow.

AllowHashForComparing.description: If true and if no specific EqualityComparer is found for the type, Diffing hashes are computed and used to compare the objects.

DiffingConfig.description: Configurations for the Diffing hashing. Requires `AllowHashForComparing` to be set to true. DiffingConfig: General configurations for the Diffing process, including settings for the Hash computation.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
